question: Can you provide a breakdown of how many times each product was viewed, how many times they were added to the shopping cart, and how many times they were left in the cart without being purchased? Also, give me the count of actual purchases for each product. Ensure that products with a page id in (1, 2, 12, 13) are filtered out.
sql:
WITH product_events AS (
    SELECT 
        ph.product_id,
        sh.event_type,
        COUNT(*) as event_count
    FROM shopping_cart_events sh
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy ph ON sh.page_id = ph.page_id
    WHERE sh.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
    GROUP BY ph.product_id, sh.event_type
)
SELECT 
    product_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 1 THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) as page_views,
    SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 2 THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) as added_to_cart,
    SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 3 THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) as purchases,
    SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 2 THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 3 THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) as left_in_cart
FROM product_events
GROUP BY product_id
ORDER BY product_id

    SELECT 
        ph.product_id,
        sh.event_type,

    product_id,
    event_type,
    event_count
FROM event_counts
ORDER BY product_id, event_type
